summary: Iteration 54 — Frontend-only verification of the AutoText alias rollout extension. ALL listed screens/cards translate end-to-end in EN/ES/IT, with the expected ~1–2s English flash then re-render after a single batched POST /api/translate completes. (1) HOME — clicking lang-it (testID lang-it) flips the bottom tabs and quick-action grid immediately (Preghiera/Diario/Spesa/Bibbia/Calendario/Chiese/Esame/Autodifesa/Opere di carità + Oggi/Pasti/Allen…/Benes…/Santu…/Parro…/Profili). After ~3-9s the four Home cards render fully in Italian: Daily Devotion (devotion-card → 'Gloria al Padre' + 'Gloria al Padre e al Figlio e allo Spirito Santo…'); Catechism in 90 Seconds (catechism-card → 'CATECHISMO IN 90 SECONDI', 'Il mistero centrale', body about la Trinità, 'Rifletti'); Saint of the Day (saint-of-day-card → 'SANTO DEL GIORNO', 'San Silverio' + Italian quote, 'Leggi di più'); Today's Practice (daily-practice-card → 'PRATICA DI OGGI', 'SACRAMENTO', 'Trascorri 30 minuti in Adorazione Eucaristica…', 'Adorazione', 'Moderato', 'Mostra di più', 'Segna come completato', 'Aggiungi nota'). (2) /virtus hub headings + body translate ('Virtus / Cresci nella santità, una virtù alla volta / La scuola della virtù / Studia le virtù, impara a viverle… / Lavora su una virtù / Scegli una o più virtù… / 7/14/30/60 giorni / Scegli una virtù per iniziare / I TUOI PIANI / LE VIRTÙ / termina il'). (3) /virtus/chastity (virtue detail) fully Italian after ~12s: 'Castità', 'Purezza di cuore, di corpo e d'intenzione', 'Opposta alla Lussuria', 'Che cos'è la Castità?', the full 1300-char body, plus accordion section titles 'Attraverso le stagioni della vita / Vincere la Lussuria / Santi di questa virtù / Risorse per approfondire'. (4) /virtus/plan/vp_f86e7cb51488 (active plan): 'Il Tuo Piano delle Virtù', 'Castità · Temperanza · Umiltà', 'CALENDARIO', day abbrev 'Ven/Sab/Dom/Lun/Mar/Mer/Gio', 'Giovedì 25 giugno', virtue headings 'Castità/Temperanza/Umiltà', goal labels 'FARE'/'ASTENERSI' and every goal body text rendered in Italian. (5) /challenges — header 'Sfide Liturgiche', full intro 'Tre cammini sacri attraverso l'anno liturgico…' and each card (Tempo di Ognissanti, Avvento, Quaresima, Consacrazione a San Giuseppe) with INIZIA dates + Italian descriptions, 'Monitoraggio della partecipazione', 'Conta la sequenza + i check-in giornalieri'. (6) /challenges/hallowtide detail — 'Tempo di Ognissanti', 'Dalla Vigilia di Ognissanti all'Ottava dei Defunti', 'Patrono · Tutte le Anime Sante del Purgatorio', 'PREGHIERA INIZIALE' with full L'eterno riposo… body, 'PREPARAZIONE' with 'Preparare i Soul Cakes — una tradizione cattolica…' and Italian recipe text. (7) SPANISH (testID lang-es) re-verified on Catechism card ('CATECISMO EN 90 SEGUNDOS', 'El misterio central', body, 'Reflexionar') and the active Virtue Plan ('Tu Plan de Virtudes', 'Castidad · Templanza · Humildad', day abbrev 'Vie/Sáb/Dom/Lun/Mar/Mié/Jue', 'HACER'/'ABSTENERSE', full Spanish goal bodies). (8) Switch back to EN (testID lang-en) restores English on Home Daily Devotion, Catechism, Saint of the Day, and on the UI literals of Today's Practice ('Moderate / Show more / Mark complete / Add note'). 8 distinct POST /api/translate batches observed (200 OK each) across the run, each returning the expected Italian/Spanish items. The earlier flash-of-English race noted in iteration 53 is unchanged and acceptable.

ui_bugs.issue: After switching from ES/IT back to EN, the practice TITLE/BODY/CATEGORY/INTENSITY-label remain in the previously-selected language (e.g. 'SACRAMENTO / Pasar 30 minutos en Adoración Eucarística / Encuentra una capilla… / Adoración') until a hard reload or date change. Root cause: /api/daily-practice returns server-localized content using Accept-Language at fetch time, and DailyPracticeCard does not re-fetch when the i18n language changes. AutoText correctly renders verbatim in EN mode, but the children it receives are the cached Spanish strings from the original fetch. Same likely applies on first language flip for Saint of the Day quote and any other backend-localized content card. Suggest adding `lang` (from useI18n) to the `useEffect`/`useCallback` dependency array so the card re-fetches on language change.

action_items: (Polish) In DailyPracticeCard (and any sibling cards that pull localized strings from the backend via Accept-Language), add the current i18n `lang` to the load() dependency array so switching EN/ES/IT triggers a re-fetch and the localized backend content updates without a reload. Today this only leaves stale Spanish/Italian until next navigation, which is minor.

(Optional) Pre-warm the AutoText cache at app boot for frequently-used screen literals so the first navigation after a language switch doesn't flash English for 1-2s. Already documented in iteration 53; remains acceptable as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: The AutoText alias-import pattern continues to work cleanly: every wrapped screen makes exactly one batched POST /api/translate per fresh visit with the full set of literal strings, then a single state update flips the whole screen. Confirmed for catechism/saint/devotion/today-practice cards plus /virtus, /virtus/[slug], /virtus/plan/[id], /challenges, /challenges/[slug].

Backend Accept-Language localization (used by daily-practice / virtues plans / challenges-day APIs) overlaps with the client-side AutoText cache without conflict — strings already in the target language fall through AutoText's English-only enqueue gate (mostly), and the few cross-language survivors are user-invisible. Only DailyPracticeCard exhibits a noticeable stale-language footprint when reverting EN.

success_rate.frontend: ~99% (all in-scope screens translate in EN/ES/IT; one polish-tier stale-fetch issue on DailyPracticeCard after language toggle)

The only follow-up worth verifying is whether main agent adds the i18n-lang dependency to DailyPracticeCard's load() so the practice card refetches localized content on language switch; otherwise nothing else to retest in this area.
rca_of_issue: DailyPracticeCard stale-content RCA: the card's useEffect → load() depends only on `date`. When the user toggles language, useI18n updates Accept-Language for subsequent /api requests, but DailyPracticeCard never re-runs load(), so its state still holds the title/body fetched in the previous language. Adding `lang` from useI18n to the load() useCallback deps (and thus the useEffect dep that calls it) will trigger a single re-fetch on toggle, after which the card displays the freshly-localized content.
